## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Purpose

This FSD defines the functional specifications for enabling concurrent execution of independent SDLC phases using LangGraph fan-out/fan-in patterns within the SDLC Pipeline Graph. It details use cases, business rules, data specifications, integration points, processing logic, and error handling required to implement SA4E-205.

### 1.2 Scope

Reference BRD scope: Enable concurrent execution of independent SDLC phases using LangGraph fan-out/fan-in within SDLC Pipeline Graph, introducing state merge strategy, join nodes, and per-branch error handling.

Technical scope clarifications:
- Implementation limited to pipeline graph orchestration layer; no UI changes per BRD.
- State merge strategy and dependency detection algorithm to be defined by System Architect.
- Integration with existing LangGraph runtime and SA4E-204 parallel tool execution benefits.

### 1.3 Definitions & Acronyms

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| Fan-out/Fan-in | Pattern where work is distributed to parallel branches then joined |
| Join Node | LangGraph node that waits for multiple incoming branches |
| State Merge | Combining state objects from parallel branches into one |
| SDLC Pipeline Graph | LangGraph workflow representing SDLC phases |

## 2. System Overview

### 2.1 System Context Diagram

![System Context](data:image/png;base64,)

*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/system-context.drawio)*

The SDLC Pipeline Graph interacts with LangGraph Runtime for orchestration, Phase Executor for concurrent phase runs, State Manager for merge strategy, and Error Handler for per-branch isolation. External inputs are SDLC jobs with dependency graphs.

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph System
        Pipeline[SDLC Pipeline Graph]
        Runtime[LangGraph Runtime]
        Executor[Phase Executor]
        StateMgr[State Manager]
        ErrHandler[Error Handler]
    end
    Job[SDLC Job]
    Job --> Pipeline
    Pipeline --> Runtime
    Runtime --> Executor
    Executor --> StateMgr
    Executor --> ErrHandler
    StateMgr --> Pipeline
```

### 2.2 System Architecture

High-level architecture comprises:
- **Orchestration Layer**: LangGraph-based pipeline graph with fan-out/fan-in nodes.
- **Phase Identification Service**: Detects independent phases from dependency graph.
- **Parallel Executor**: Executes eligible phases concurrently using LangGraph.
- **State Merge Service**: Implements merge strategies for join nodes.
- **Error Isolation Service**: Captures per-branch errors and applies join policies.

Existing codebase modules relevant to orchestration are in `backend/modules/` and extension `langgraph/core/`. Data persistence via Knowledge Module SQLite.

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1 Feature: Parallel Phase Execution for Throughput

**Source:** BRD Story 1 — As a SDLC Pipeline Engineer...

#### 3.1.1 Description

Enable LangGraph fan-out/fan-in pattern to identify independent SDLC phases at runtime and execute them concurrently.

#### 3.1.2 Use Case

**Use Case ID:** UC-1
**Actor:** SDLC Pipeline Engineer
**Preconditions:** SDLC job with phase dependency graph is submitted; LangGraph runtime supports fan-out/fan-in.
**Postconditions:** Independent phases are executed concurrently; pipeline state reflects merged results.

**Main Flow:**

| Step | Actor | System | Description |
|------|-------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | Engineer | | Submits SDLC job |
| 2 | | System | Parses dependency graph |
| 3 | | System | Identifies phases with no unresolved dependencies |
| 4 | | System | Fan-out state to parallel branches |
| 5 | | System | Executes branches concurrently |
| 6 | | System | Join node waits for completion |
| 7 | | System | Continues to next phase |

**Alternative Flows:**
| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| AF-1 | No independent phases | Skip fan-out, continue sequential |

**Exception Flows:**
| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| EF-1 | Dependency detection fails | Log error, fallback to sequential execution |

#### 3.1.3 Business Rules

| Rule ID | Rule | Source |
|---------|------|--------|
| BR-1 | Only phases with `can_parallelize=true` and zero unresolved dependencies may be fanned out | BRD Story 1 |
| BR-2 | Fan-out must preserve immutable state snapshot per branch | BRD Risks |

#### 3.1.4 Data Specifications

**Input Data:**

| Field | Type | Required | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|------------|-------------|
| phase_id | string | Y | Non-empty | Unique identifier |
| dependencies | array | Y | Array of strings | Phase IDs this phase depends on |
| can_parallelize | boolean | Y | true/false | Flag for parallel eligibility |

**Output Data:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| execution_time_ms | number | Duration of parallel execution |
| branches_executed | number | Count of parallel branches |

#### 3.1.5 UI Specifications

No UI per BRD.

#### 3.1.6 API Contract (Functional View)

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/pipeline/execute`
**Purpose:** Trigger pipeline with parallel execution enabled.

**Input Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Business Rule | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------------|-------------|
| job_id | string | Y | BR-1 | Pipeline job identifier |
| enable_parallel | boolean | Y | | Toggle parallel execution |

**Business Error Scenarios:**
| Scenario | User Message | Trigger Condition |
|----------|-------------|-------------------|
| Dependency cycle detected | Cannot execute pipeline with cyclic dependencies | Graph validation fails |

### 3.2 Feature: State Merge Strategy for Fan-In Join Nodes

**Source:** BRD Story 2

#### 3.2.1 Description

Implement deterministic state merge strategy for joining parallel branch outputs without data loss.

#### 3.2.2 Use Case

**Use Case ID:** UC-2
**Actor:** System Architect
**Preconditions:** Parallel branches have completed execution.
**Postconditions:** Unified state contains all branch outputs.

**Main Flow:**
...


**Main Flow:**

| Step | Actor | System | Description |
|------|-------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | | System | Join node receives branch results |
| 2 | | System | Apply merge_strategy to combine states |
| 3 | | System | Resolve conflicts per strategy |
| 4 | | System | Produce merged state |

**Alternative Flows:**
| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| AF-1 | Conflict keys present | Apply conflict resolution rule |

**Exception Flows:**
| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| EF-1 | Merge conflict unresolvable | Log warning, apply default last-write-wins |

#### 3.2.3 Business Rules

| Rule ID | Rule | Source |
|---------|------|--------|
| BR-3 | Merge operation must be idempotent | BRD Story 2 |
| BR-4 | Conflict resolution follows configured merge_strategy | BRD Story 2 |

#### 3.2.4 Data Specifications

**Input Data:**

| Field | Type | Required | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|------------|-------------|
| merge_strategy | string | Y | enum | e.g., merge-deep, last-write-wins |
| conflict_keys | array | N | | Keys with conflicts |

**Output Data:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| merged_state | object | Unified state after merge |
| conflicts_resolved | number | Count of conflicts handled |

---

### 3.3 Feature: Per-Branch Error Handling

**Source:** BRD Story 3

#### 3.3.1 Description

Implement per-branch error capture and join node policy for partial failures.

#### 3.3.2 Use Case

**Use Case ID:** UC-3
**Actor:** QA Engineer
**Preconditions:** Parallel execution in progress.
**Postconditions:** Errors isolated per branch; pipeline policy applied.

**Main Flow:**

| Step | Actor | System | Description |
|------|-------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | | System | Branch execution fails |
| 2 | | System | Capture error_code, error_message, branch_id |
| 3 | | System | Continue other branches |
| 4 | | System | Join node evaluates policy |

**Exception Flows:**
| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| EF-1 | Critical branch fails | Pipeline fails per policy |

#### 3.3.3 Business Rules

| Rule ID | Rule | Source |
|---------|------|--------|
| BR-5 | Errors in one branch must not block others unless policy requires | BRD Story 3 |
| BR-6 | Error details logged with traceability | BRD Story 3 |

#### 3.3.4 Data Specifications

**Input Data:**

| Field | Type | Required | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|------------|-------------|
| branch_id | string | Y | Non-empty | Identifier |
| error_code | string | N | | Error code |
| error_message | string | N | | Human readable |

## 6. Processing Logic

### 6.1 Parallel Phase Execution Process

**Trigger:** SDLC job submission with enable_parallel=true
**Schedule:** On-demand
**Input:** Phase dependency graph
**Output:** Merged state

**Processing Steps:**

| Step | Description | Error Handling |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| 1 | Identify independent phases | Log and fallback to sequential |
| 2 | Fan-out state | Validate snapshot immutability |
| 3 | Execute concurrently | Per-branch error capture |
| 4 | Join & merge | Apply merge strategy, log conflicts |

**Activity Diagram:**

![Activity - Parallel Execution](data:image/png;base64,)

*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/activity-parallel-execution.drawio)*

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant Pipeline
    participant Runtime
    participant Executor
    participant StateMgr
    Client->>Pipeline: Execute job
    Pipeline->>Runtime: Fan-out branches
    Runtime->>Executor: Execute phase A
    Runtime->>Executor: Execute phase B
    Executor-->>Runtime: Results / Errors
    Runtime->>StateMgr: Merge states
    StateMgr-->>Pipeline: Merged state
    Pipeline-->>Client: Completion
```

## 9. Error Handling (User-Facing)

### 9.1 Error Scenarios

| Scenario | Severity | User Message | Expected Behavior |
|----------|----------|-------------|-------------------|

| Merge conflict | Warning | State merge conflict detected | Apply resolution strategy, log |

| ID | Scenario | Input | Expected Output | Priority |
